grep: grep is a command-line utility for searching plain-text data for lines matching a regular expression.
To use grep: grep 'pattern' filename. For recursive search: grep -r 'pattern' directory.
grep supports many options like -i (case insensitive), -v (invert match), -n (show line numbers).
curl: curl is a command-line tool for transferring data with URLs.
Basic usage: curl https://example.com. Use -o to save output to file.
curl supports many protocols including HTTP, HTTPS, FTP, and more.
docker: Docker is a platform for developing, shipping, and running applications in containers.
Basic commands: docker build, docker run, docker ps, docker stop.
Docker allows you to package an application with all its dependencies into a standardized unit.
linux: Linux is a family of open-source Unix-like operating systems.
Popular distributions include Ubuntu, Fedora, Debian, and CentOS.
Linux is widely used in servers, embedded systems, and personal computers.
security: Security is important for protecting systems and data from threats.
Best practices include using strong passwords, keeping software updated, and following the principle of least privilege.
Security involves both technical measures and user education.
